from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyExpenseReport(BaseModel):
    """Operating and administrative expenses reported in one company's financial filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    expense_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item label as written (e.g., 'Total operating expenses', 'Expenses from operations', 'Total expenses')")
    expense_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric expense amount as reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 'three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt containing the expense line")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expense_reports: list[CompanyExpenseReport]
